render_rule: Render or record each script separately, convert to 16 kHz mono PCM16, then append exactly 80000 zero-valued frames with append_trailing_silence.py. Retain the raw render and final WAV hashes. Do not concatenate utterances or add extra padding after this step.
qa_rule: Before inference, listen to each final WAV and record independent ASR wording, title, date, confirmation phrase, and any mismatch in qa_receipt_template.json format. Exclude unclear or misworded recordings without inspecting model outputs.
